mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the FEDFUNDS rate above 5.25% for 4 consecutive months reduces the real discount rate applied to equities, thereby depressing near-term expected returns and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 5.25% and remains above for 4 consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns over the 60-day window are not statistically different from a zero return baseline (p > 0.05) in the identified regime.

mechanism_narrative: When the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation rate exceeds 0.3% for three consecutive months, the market anticipates a tighter policy path, causing a short-term (5-day) S&P 500 decline as investors price in higher future discount rates.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 0.3% and remains above for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not statistically negative (p > 0.05) when the trigger is active.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in PAYEMS employment figures followed by a decline in UNRATE suggests strengthening labor market conditions that outpace wage growth, leading to positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by > 2% in one month and UNRATE falls by > 0.2% in the following month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05) during the interaction window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in GDPC1 personal consumption exceeding 3% for two consecutive months indicates robust demand momentum that persists into the next 60-day period, producing positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are flat or negative despite sustained consumption growth (t-test p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the INDPRO supply index falls by more than 5 points in a single month, it reflects production softness that reduces future earnings expectations, resulting in negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO decreases by > 5 points in one month
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during the trigger period.

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive monthly increases in both HOUST housing starts and PAYEMS nonfarm payrolls exceeding 5% each suggest a dual labor and housing demand surge, driving positive 5-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases by > 5% in one month AND PAYEMS increases by > 5% in the same month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05) when both proxies move in the predicted direction.

mechanism_narrative: During a regime of falling UNRATE below 5%, the market anticipates looser monetary policy, which supports equity valuations and produces positive 20-day S&P 500 returns even without explicit rate cuts.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 5% and remains below for 4 consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05) during the regime.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 4-month decline in RSAFS commercial and industrial loan growth signals over-loaning in the corporate sector, which erodes earnings quality and drives negative 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during the 4-month decline.
